description.en: The content of the command to execute.

description.zh: 脚本内容的编码方式。若该参数传入的值不在枚举值范围内，则一律视为传入默认值`PlainText`。
description.en: The encoding of the command content. If you provide a value that is not a valid option, the system uses the default value, `PlainText`.

description.zh: 云手机实例ID列表。一次请求最多支持50个实例。
description.en: An array of Cloud Phone instance IDs. You can specify up to 50 instances in a single request.

description.zh: 等待时间，单位为毫秒。取值范围500\~3000，默认值为1000。
description.en: The timeout for command execution, in milliseconds. Valid range: 500 to 3000. Default: 1000.

descriptions.zh: `RunSyncCommand`适合能快速返回结果（毫秒级）的命令。对于执行时间较长（秒级）的命令，建议使用[RunCommand](~~RunCommand~~)接口。
descriptions.en: The `RunSyncCommand` operation is designed for commands that return a result quickly, typically within milliseconds. For longer-running commands that may take several seconds, we recommend using the asynchronous [](t2729835.xdita#)operation.
